s.en: filter to normalize DBI trace logs for diff'ing

syn: Read DBI trace file "dbitrace.log" and write out a stripped version to "dbitrace_stripped.log" ⏎ dbilogstrip dbitrace.log > dbitrace_stripped.log ⏎ Run "yourscript.pl" twice, each with different sets of arguments, with DBI_TRACE enabled. Filter the output and trace through "dbilogstrip" into a separate file for each run. Then compare using diff. (This example assumes you're using a standard shell.) ⏎ DBI_TRACE=2 perl yourscript.pl ...args1... 2>&1 | dbilogstrip > dbitrace1.log ⏎ DBI_TRACE=2 perl yourscript.pl ...args2... 2>&1 | dbilogstrip > dbitrace2.log ⏎ diff -u dbitrace1.log dbitrace2.log
